exact_requirements.parameters: {D : CanonicalNetInput} (A : RemainingModularCoreInput D); C := A.toCertificate; Q := regularMaxwellQuadraticForm A; T := (TGLExt.MaxwellBridge.toStress Q).toStressTensorData
exact_requirements.charge_link: ∀ ψ, Regular Q.Dom T ψ → ∀ k : ℝ, HasModularEnergy (lightDelta C) ψ k → k = 2 * Real.pi * nullPlaneCharge T ψ
exact_requirements.nontrivial: ∃ ψ, Regular Q.Dom T ψ ∧ ∃ k : ℝ, HasModularEnergy (lightDelta C) ψ k ∧ k ≠ 0
exact_requirements.nullPlaneCharge: ∫ p : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ), p.1 * pairing (T.T ψ (p.1 • nullDir + screenEmbed p.2)) nullDir nullDir
exact_requirements.HasModularEnergy: HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => inner ℂ ψ (lightDelta C t ψ)) (-(Complex.I * (k : ℂ))) 0
exact_requirements.HasBoostEnergy: HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => inner ℂ ψ ((lightBoost C).V s ψ)) (Complex.I * (b : ℂ)) 0
exact_requirements.Regular: ψ∈Dom; for EVERY x translated weighted null-plane integrand Integrable; norm ψ=1; for EVERY x null-line stress Continuous; for EVERY x,l both stress and u*stress IntegrableOn (Ioi l).

normalization.scope: Analytic calculation on a smooth compact momentum core supported away from transverse axis and u=0. The construction of this core inside H1, integral transports and the extension to every canonical Regular state have not been formalized here.
normalization.sign: POSITIVE; no minus sign and no extra factor 2
normalization.raw_identity_on_core: nullPlaneCharge(T_raw, psi) = (2*pi)^3 * b(psi), with d/ds <psi,Gamma(B0(s))psi>|0 = i*b(psi). Hence k = 2*pi*b, not 2*pi*rawCharge when b != 0.

steps.formula: dmu = d^2q dp/E = d^2q du/u; u=E-p>0; p=(|q|^2-u^2)/(2u).

On x=(lambda,lambda,z0,z1), wavePhase = exp(-i*u*lambda+i*q.z). Contracted lowered density is u*P(q)*h(q,u), with P^T P=1 and P independent of u. The u cancels du/u. N_h(lambda,z)=integral exp(-i*u*lambda+i*q.z) P(q)h(q,u) du d^2q. There is no Fourier normalization prefactor.

N is angularForward of f(q,u)=P(q)h(q,u), extended by zero to u<=0, with reflection of the transverse position coordinates. Reflection changes no absolute Jacobian and not the lambda weight. Weighted Parseval in dimension 3 gives integral lambda*<N_h,N_k> = -i*(2*pi)^3 * integral <h,partial_u k> du d^2q. P is u independent and orthogonal.

The coherent contraction is exp(<h,k>)/2 times sum_a(conj(N_h,a)+N_k,a)^2. Integrals of lambda*N_k^2 and lambda*conj(N_h)^2 vanish: their frequency supports have u+v bounded away from zero on this core. The mixed term has coefficient 1, cancelling the 1/2 against the factor 2. Diagonal normalized coherent stress is sum_a(|N_h,a|^2+Re(N_h,a^2)). Thus no residual 2.

B0(s)h(y)=h(coordinateBoost(-s)y); rapidity shifts by -s, so u maps to exp(s)*u. Therefore derivative at 0 is u*partial_u h and derivative of <h,B0(s)k> is integral <h,partial_u k> du d^2q. The boost energy is b=-i times this derivative. Raw charge is +(2*pi)^3*b.

Gamma(B0(s)) exponential(k)=exponential(B0(s)k), inner(exponential(h),exponential(k))=exp(inner(h,k)). Its derivative is exp(inner(h,k))*oneParticleDerivative. This is exactly the coherent overlap in stress. For psi_h=exp(-norm(h)^2/2)*exponential(h), overlap and norm factors cancel on both sides. Finite coherent sums preserve the same factor.
lightDelta(t)=Gamma(B0(-2*pi*t)); derivative=-2*pi*i*b=-i*k, hence k=+2*pi*b. The canonical modularEnergy_of_boostEnergy and modularEnergy_unique already encode this sign and uniqueness.

nonzero_core_witness_plan.profile: Choose nonzero real C-infinity compact rho(q,u), support away from q=0 and u=0, one fixed polarization e, and h(q,u)=exp(i*a*u)*rho(q,u)*e with a!=0. No new universal hypothesis: this is an explicit existential construction to formalize.
nonzero_core_witness_plan.calculation: integral <h,partial_u h> du dq = i*a*integral rho^2 du dq; real boundary derivative integrates to zero. Therefore b=a*integral rho^2 !=0; rawCharge=(2*pi)^3*b; normalized coherent norm=1.
nonzero_core_witness_plan.regular_obligations: Show physical h defines H1 and StrongRegularProfile, then smooth compact null-frequency amplitudes yield all translated weighted plane integrability, null-line continuity and tail integrability required by Regular. These proofs are OPEN, not supplied by pointwise T00>0.

correction_proposal.caveat: This is a proposed normalization correction, not an accepted replacement. Pin a new R3 and check the field/smearing convention before claiming literal Wick correspondence. Scaling alone does not prove the full-domain charge theorem or its witness.

separate_domain_gap.reason: StrongRegularProfile has all polynomial energy moments of norm and norm squared; it has no derivative in momentum/rapidity. Compactly supported rough profiles satisfy moment bounds, so no generator-domain assertion follows solely from those fields. separate_domain_gap.important: A scalar coefficient derivative is the definition of HasModularEnergy here; it is not automatically a strong vector derivative/domain membership. The extension must match this exact contract.
